name: easyrankly/easyrankly
description: Lightweight, modular, developer-first SEO essentials for WordPress.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Check the plugin against the EasyRankly coding standards (phpcs.xml).
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Auto-fix the coding-standard issues that can be fixed automatically.
scripts-descriptions.compat: Check PHP 8.0+ compatibility across the codebase.
scripts-descriptions.security:contract: Verify SSRF, AI rate-limit, 404 privacy, bounded JSON imports, and workflow supply-chain boundaries.
scripts-descriptions.test:concurrency: Run Phase 5, 7, and 8 standalone certifications concurrently to verify temporary-file isolation.
scripts-descriptions.performance:contract: Enforce helper, frontend bootstrap, Import/Export asset, and contextual-loader budgets.
scripts-descriptions.multilingual:test:static: Validate the M1 baseline pin, suite separation, fixture matrix, snapshot and M2/M4 defect ownership.
scripts-descriptions.multilingual:test:legacy: Run the green EasyRankly 2.0 behavior snapshot against the current bundled fallback.
scripts-descriptions.multilingual:test:conformance: Verify the M2 defects are green while the five assigned M4 defects remain expected-red.
scripts-descriptions.multilingual:test:m2: Run provider handshake, bridge, ownership, rollback, reset and uninstall contracts for EasyRankly 2.1.
scripts-descriptions.multilingual:test:writer: Certify the public allowlisted localized-source writer, CAS, verification, authorization, idempotent restore, and two-process concurrency.
scripts-descriptions.multilingual:test:scale: Run legacy-baseline against clean 3, 250 and 501 site fixtures.
scripts-descriptions.migration:certify:standalone: Run the immutable Free/PRO contract and go-live decision suites.
scripts-descriptions.migration:certify: Run the complete Docker-backed migration certification matrix and produce a release verdict.
scripts-descriptions.migration:go-live: Require a clean fresh matrix plus externally supplied authorized evidence for every PRO source.
